article:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .
Nvidia ( NASDAQ:NVDA ), the artificial-intelligence chip powerhouse, invested $3.5 billion in MediaTek convertible bonds Monday. That equals roughly 3.6% of Nvidia's latest quarterly salesa serious commitment, but one the company can comfortably absorb. Nvidia shares slipped about 0.3% to approximately $216.80.
Warning! GuruFocus has detected 4 Warning Signs with NVDA.
Is NVDA fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.
The bonds are only the opening move. Under the expanded partnership , MediaTek will use NVLink Fusion to connect customers' custom processors with Nvidia's rack-scale systems. The companies are also pushing deeper into RTX Spark and DGX Spark chips while building additional automotive-computing platforms.
Nvidia has plenty of firepower after generating $96.2 billion in second-quarter revenue . Its 95/100 GF Score tells the same story: profitability, growth and financial strength are firing, while GF Value remains the weak link. The investor takeaway is sharpNvidia is financing the spread of NVLink across custom silicon, personal AI computers and vehicles, tightening its grip on the computing ecosystem it helped create.
